market_scope: x402 List indexed services and monitored facilitators, not the x402 ecosystem
source_method_note: Net per address; self-payments excluded; listed-address forwarding deducted. Per-service volumes overlap and must not be summed. Buyer addresses are not unique people or companies.
caveats: Publisher-reported measurements are not independently audited by AgentMine.
Top service's imported flow and 98.9% concentration in one buyer address make organic demand uncertain.
Top-1 and top-10 shares are rounded, so implied volume and concentration bounds are conditional arithmetic.
Overlapping rolling 30-day windows cannot be interpreted as sales growth.
No observed AgentMine paying customers, actual routing savings, revenue or payment conversion.
